mirror.text:
🌿 Weekly pattern scan · Wed 14 Oct

End of the week. Let's look back — take whichever thread matters.

1. Energy & Themes
   • Which days had energy, which didn't — and what was behind it?
   • What kept coming up across the week?
2. Values & Alignment
   • Which values showed up this week? Which were neglected?
3. Dropped Threads
   • What intentions or promises slipped — to yourself or others?
4. Wins
   • What's worth celebrating from the week, even small?
5. Connections
   • Who showed up for you, and who did you show up for?
6. Forward
   • What do you want to carry forward from this week?
   • What thread do you want to pull next week?
   • What would make next week feel aligned?
